company.shortDescription: Roxels provides an AI voice agent that guides users through onboarding, setup flows, and data collection inside software and live calls.
company.description: Roxels develops an AI-powered voice agent that helps software companies guide users through complex workflows. The platform joins browser-based sessions or live calls, holds natural voice conversations in multiple languages, and observes the user’s screen in real time. It walks customers through onboarding, product configuration, and form completion, or can complete flows on their behalf when delegated. Roxels validates inputs as they are provided, adapts questions based on previous answers, and handles conditional logic in forms and checklists. At the end of each session, it produces structured outputs such as completed records, configuration details, and summaries, which are delivered to client systems via webhooks or documentation. The product is used in customer onboarding, guided setup and forms, and other operational data collection scenarios where structured information must be captured accurately from end users.
